shared: Lights lure enemy attacks off target, and the top cards make the enemy army hit itself.
differ: Where the misdirection lives: lanterns on your units, lights in empty slots, or fight-start tricks.

takes.label: Lantern-carrying front row
takes.line: Attacks on your units bounce into the attacker's own side, even its biggest unit, and you keep half of what they kill.
takes.look_if: the enemy's own carry to kill its other carry.

takes.label: Treasure in the gaps
takes.line: Empty slots hold lasting lights that waste enemy swings and bank stats; putting a unit there later cashes the bank in.
takes.look_if: to save stats up in empty slots for one big reveal.

takes.label: Dodges and dirty tricks
takes.line: Start of Combat effects mark enemies to hit their own side; your units dodge into empty slots beside them and grow.
takes.look_if: to rig the enemy's attacks before the fight begins.
